newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Usko busy on takeover rumours - dealers. [CORRECTED 14:20 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Usko busy on takeover rumours - dealers. [CORRECTED 14:20 GMT]

text.p: Share dealings in Usko Ltd, a South African electrical products firm, were brisk on Monday on rumours that the group may be taken over, Johannesburg Stock Exchange dealers said.
By 1320 GMT over 4.5 million Usko shares had changed hands, more than half its average monthly trade and making it the second most active stock on the bourse.

"There is speculation that there is a deal on the cards. It could be that they are going to be taken over," said Alan Davidowitz, a private client fund manager at Standard Equities, which had traded large volumes of Usko shares.
An Usko spokesman said he could shed no light on the heavy volumes.
Usko in January announced that unspecified negotiations, which it first announced in November, had been terminated. (Corrects to delete reference to Omega Holdings having discussions with Usko).
Usko shares were last up three cents to 43 cents, midway between its year high of 53 cents and low of 35.
